US Accuses India and 40+ Nations of Aiding China's Tariff Evasion

The United States has accused India and over 40 other countries of helping China evade tariffs. A White House report, cited by US officials, claims that goods from China are being transshipped through these nations to reach the US. Trump aide Peter Navarro stated that India is "well on our radar" regarding this issue. The US plans to use artificial intelligence to identify companies involved in this alleged tariff evasion scheme. This accusation comes as the US withdraws its last aircraft carrier from Asia, shifting focus to Iran and the Western Hemisphere.
